row_col: zero based, row 0 is northmost; xllcorner/yllcorner describe southwest outside corner
nodata: closed void; never a receiving cell or automatic drain
boundary: valid outermost raster cells are allowed exits; no inflow from outside
depression: fill to least elevation permitting drainage to a valid outer boundary; preserve fill depth and original elevations
flow: single D8 receiver per valid non-exit cell; maximal downward slope by center distance where strict descent exists; choose and document deterministic tie and flat routing without cycles
accumulation: one unit per valid cell including itself; also report square-meter contributing area
outlets: specified cells must be valid; basin is set of cells whose receiver chain visits it; nested basin overlap is allowed and must be explained
closed_components: a valid component disconnected from any valid outer boundary by nodata is unresolved, not silently drained through nodata
